instrumentation.main_state: aiState emits p1 frame, x/y/scale, action, hp, ql, sw, touch, touchFloor, hits, pause, hstm, hurtSkling

screenshot_order: poll flashlog.txt for the p1 frame796 state line
query Flash Player Debugger window bounds
conclusion: The Flash PNG proves that a state event was observed, but does not prove that the main clip, nested presentation clips, or interval-driven effects were frozen at frame796. It cannot be used as a strict same-child-frame visual parity oracle. A valid follow-up requires an analysis-only recursive freeze hook in the temporary SWF before emitting the target state event, plus child/presentation frame logging.
